login.title: Lab Console
login.subtitle: Consoles of the networking lab's equipment
login.localHint: For accounts created through an invitation and for the server's administrator. Students of the school use the button above.
login.localHintAlone: Sign in with the account your invitation created, or with the server's administration account.
login.codeHint: Only for the server's administration account: the code of its authenticator app.
login.missing: Fill in the user name and the password.
login.network: The server does not answer. Check your connection and try again.
login.passkeyFailed: Signing in with the passkey failed. Try again, or use your password.

messages.sso_disabled: Signing in through an identity provider is not configured on this server.
messages.provider_unavailable: The identity provider does not answer. Try again in a moment; the local administrator can still sign in.
messages.sso_failed: Sign-in failed: the identity provider's answer was refused. Start again from this page.
messages.not_allowed: Your account is in none of the groups allowed to use Lab Console. Ask your teacher to add you.
messages.login_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired or was already used. Start again from this page.
messages.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts from your computer. Wait a minute and try again.
messages.account_disabled: Your Lab Console account is disabled. Ask an administrator.

errors.invalid_credentials: Sign-in refused. Check the user name, the password and, for the server's administrator, the code.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.

step.enrolText: Your account is an administrator: it signs in with a passkey (fingerprint, device PIN or security key). Register one now; your password alone will no longer be enough.
step.useText: Your account is an administrator: after the password, your passkey is needed.
step.cancelled: Cancelled. Start again when you are ready.
step.failed: The browser could not use a passkey. Try again, or try another device.
